tasks.title: Audit the Domain and Application layers
acceptance: `docs/audit/01-domain-application.md` exists and conforms to `contracts/audit-record-format.md`: the six sections `## Scope`, `## Method`, `## Summary`, `## Records`, `## Layer verdict`, `## Attestation` appear in that order, and every record is a level-3 heading of the form `### <ID> -- <title>` followed immediately by a fenced `yaml` block and then the three bolded paragraphs **What.**, **Why it matters.**, **Suggested direction.** in that order.

Every record's YAML block carries the eleven required keys in the contract's order (`id`, `layer`, `severity`, `category`, `authority`, `citation`, `locations`, `effort`, `risk`, `independent`, plus `blocked-by` only when `independent: false`), with `layer: CORE` on every record and values drawn only from the contract's enumerated token sets.
Record IDs run `CORE-001` upward, gapless and in ascending order in `## Records`, and the `## Summary` table's S1-S5 counts and total exactly equal the number of record blocks at each severity.

Every record's `locations` list has at least one entry of the form `<repo-relative path>:<line>` or `<repo-relative path>:<start>-<end>` that resolves to a real file in the repository at the base commit; no record cites a file without a line number.

Every record names an `authority` from `microsoft` | `conventions` | `practice` | `judgment`; every `microsoft` record cites a full `https://learn.microsoft.com/...` URL, every `conventions` record cites `<path>#<verbatim section heading>`, every `practice` record cites a named source, every `judgment` record cites `n/a` and is worded as belief rather than fact, and every `S5` record carries `authority: judgment`.
`## Method` lists the `dm-conventions` documents read with line counts and states explicitly that `backend/dotnet-format.md` was read in full; no record contradicts a rule stated in that document.

`## Scope` reports, as a table, the directories audited with file and line counts covering all 20 `.cs` files of `src/DungeonMaster.Domain` and all 57 `.cs` files of `src/DungeonMaster.Application`, and names anything excluded with a reason.

The hand-rolled CQRS dispatcher (`src/DungeonMaster.Application/Common/Dispatch/`), the `Result`/`ErrorCategory` error model (`Common/Results/`), the `ValidationBehavior` pipeline behavior, and the partial-entity `X.cs`/`XMethods.cs` split in `Domain/Entities/` are each either the subject of at least one record or named explicitly in `## Layer verdict` as sound, with a stated reason.
`## Layer verdict` is 150-400 words and answers both audit axes for these layers: whether the layer holds its shape, and whether its internal seams sit in the right places.

No file under `src/` was created, modified, or deleted: `git status --porcelain` shows no entry under `src/`, and the only path this task added is `docs/audit/01-domain-application.md`. The `## Attestation` section carries the contract's three lines verbatim.

Every file in this task's scope is accounted for: each file is either cited in the `locations` of at least one record, or listed in `## Scope` as read and found sound. `## Scope` states two counts -- files read and files cited -- and the files-read count equals the total file count in its own scope table.

tasks.title: Audit the solution and build configuration and the layer boundaries, then synthesise the master index
acceptance: `docs/audit/06-cross-cutting.md` exists and conforms to `contracts/audit-record-format.md`: the six sections in the contract's order, every record a level-3 heading followed immediately by a fenced `yaml` block and then **What.**, **Why it matters.**, **Suggested direction.**, every YAML block carrying the eleven required keys in the contract's order with `layer: XCUT`, IDs running `XCUT-001` upward gapless and ascending, and `## Summary` counts equal to the actual record counts.

Every `XCUT` record's `locations` list has at least one `path:line` or `path:start-end` entry; records about an absent file (`.editorconfig`, analyzer configuration) cite the file where the configuration would belong -- `Directory.Build.props:1` or the relevant `.csproj` -- rather than a path that does not exist.

Every `XCUT` record names an `authority` from the four-token set with the citation form that token requires; `judgment` records cite `n/a` and are worded as belief; every `S5` record carries `authority: judgment`. `## Method` states explicitly that `backend/dotnet-format.md` was read in full before any style or formatting record, and no record contradicts a rule stated in that document.

`docs/audit/06-cross-cutting.md` covers, each with at least one record or an explicit statement of soundness with a reason in `## Layer verdict`: `Directory.Build.props`; each of the five `.csproj` files including package versions and the transitive `SQLitePCLRaw.lib.e_sqlite3` pin; `src/DungeonMaster.sln`; the absence of any `.editorconfig` in the repository; and the absence of analyzer package references and of any `AnalysisLevel` or `EnableNETAnalyzers` property.

`docs/audit/06-cross-cutting.md` records the layer *boundaries* as distinct from the layers: Domain-to-Application, Application-to-Infrastructure, Application/Infrastructure-to-App, and the Tests project's reach into each. Every boundary defect reported by T1-T5 as belonging to a boundary rather than a layer appears here as an `XCUT` record.

`docs/audit/00-master-index.md` exists and conforms to `contracts/master-index-format.md`: the eight sections `## Verdict`, `## Per-layer verdicts`, `## Boundaries`, `## Source documents`, `## Master index`, `## Merged groups`, `## Suggested fix sessions`, `## Coverage attestation` appear in that order with the specified tables and columns, and master entry IDs run `MASTER-001` upward, gapless, in final rank order.

The `## Master index` table is ranked ascending by severity, then ascending by effort, then ascending by risk, then by first source ID, exactly as the contract specifies; every row's `Sources` cell lists at least one source record ID, and every entry with more than one source has a matching bullet in `## Merged groups` naming the single shared fix that justifies the merge.

`## Source documents` reports per-document S1-S5 counts that equal each source document's own `## Summary` table, and `## Coverage attestation` shows the reconciliation arithmetic with real numbers such that source record count minus merges equals master entry count, with every source record ID appearing in exactly one master entry.

`## Suggested fix sessions` contains between three and eight sessions in recommended execution order, each with its entry list, combined effort, highest risk, and rationale; every `S1` and `S2` master entry is assigned to exactly one session; no entry precedes a session containing a record it is `blocked-by`; and any unassigned `S3`-`S5` entries are listed with a reason.

`## Verdict` is 300-600 words stating a solution-level position on both audit axes in its first sentence, `## Per-layer verdicts` has one 60-120 word paragraph per layer in code order, and `## Boundaries` assesses each named layer pair for dependency direction, surface area, and the types crossing it.

No file under `src/` was created, modified, or deleted: `git status --porcelain` shows no entry under `src/`, and the only paths this task added are `docs/audit/06-cross-cutting.md` and `docs/audit/00-master-index.md`. The `## Attestation` section of `docs/audit/06-cross-cutting.md` and the `## Coverage attestation` section of `docs/audit/00-master-index.md` both carry their contract's lines verbatim.
